title: ExternalAccountHierarchy - Data API
description: Represents the external account hierarchy, which works like a role-based hierarchy. Use ExternalAccountHierarchy to allow partner and customer users to share data with other external accounts in their hierarchy.This object is available in API version 49.0 and later.

AccountId.description: The ID of the account in the external account hierarchy.

CurrencyISOCode.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
CurrencyISOCode.description: Possible values are: GBP— British Pound USD— U.S. Dollar The default value is USD.

Description.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Description.description: The description of the external account hierarchy.

HierarchyType.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort
HierarchyType.description: Possible values are: CustomerPortal — Customer Partner The default value is Partner.

IsAccessibleToParent.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsAccessibleToParent.description: Allows data to be shared with parent account in the account hierarchy. The default value is true.

IsActive.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsActive.description: When true, the hierarchy is turned on. The default value is false.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed a record related to this record.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed this record. If this value is null, this record might only have been referenced (LastReferencedDate) and not viewed.

Name.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update
Name.description: Name of the external account hierarchy.

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: The ID of the account owner.

ParentId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ParentId.description: The ID of the parent account.

special_access_rules: You must have a Partner or Customer Community Plus license.
